get_dataset: get a test dataset for classifying dominant color in synthetic images with configurable split and image size
generate_data: generate synthetic RGB images flood filled with a single color channel and perturbed with uniform noise
to_minibatch: convert a generated image and label example into a MiniBatch for classification or multi-label classification tasks
compute_num_examples: compute the number of examples in a dataset slice given total length and optional start and end offsets
task_key: create a TaskKey with classification or multi-label classification metadata for the test dataset with three classes
